purpose: Treat one item as obvious and add another beyond it.
keywords: Noun / nominalized clause + はもちろん
He speaks Chinese as well as, of course, English.
This restaurant has a good atmosphere as well as good food.
It is crowded on weekdays as well as weekends.
formation: Noun / nominalized clause + はもちろん
restrictions: Often followed by a second item marked with も or まで.
mistake: The second fact is an addition, not a contradiction of the first.
